name: intervals-mcp-with-stryd
description: An Intervals.icu MCP server built for Stryd runners — power-based running analysis (a dual PMC with RSS and LBSS), designed so the LLM never does the math.

athlete_id.title: Intervals.icu Athlete ID
athlete_id.description: Your athlete ID (starts with "i", e.g. i12345678), from the Intervals.icu URL or Settings. You may also use "0" for the API key owner.

api_key.title: Intervals.icu API Key
api_key.description: API key from Intervals.icu → Settings → Developer. Stored in your OS keychain.

timezone.title: Athlete Timezone (IANA)
timezone.description: IANA timezone name, e.g. Asia/Tokyo or UTC. Affects "today" and Mon–Sun week boundaries.

tools.name: get_activities
tools.description: Fetch a list of Intervals.icu activities for a date range.

tools.name: get_activity_detail
tools.description: Fetch complete data for a single Intervals.icu activity, including power/HR zone distributions (icu_zone_times, icu_hr_zone_times), Stryd metrics (StrydLBSSmod, StrydILR), decoupling, and all other fields.

tools.name: get_activity_streams_summary
tools.description: Fetch activity stream data, clean/split/aggregate, and return a summary with splits, cardiac decoupling, and efficiency metrics.

tools.name: search_similar_activities
tools.description: Search past activities within a date range using optional filters (type, name keyword, distance, duration, temperature).

tools.name: get_wellness
tools.description: Fetch daily wellness data for a date range from Intervals.icu.

tools.name: get_athlete_summary
tools.description: Fetch an aggregated athlete summary for a date range from Intervals.icu.

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Fetch calendar events (planned workouts, races, notes) from Intervals.icu for a date range.

tools.name: create_events
tools.description: Create one or more calendar events (planned workouts, races, notes) on Intervals.icu.

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: Update an existing calendar event on Intervals.icu.

tools.name: delete_event
tools.description: Delete a calendar event from Intervals.icu.

tools.name: delete_events
tools.description: Delete multiple calendar events from Intervals.icu in one call.

tools.name: get_hrv_trends
tools.description: Calculate rolling HRV statistics (mean, SD, coefficient of variation) for recovery trend analysis.

tools.name: clear_cache
tools.description: Clear the on-disk stream cache (all cached activities, or a single one).

tools.name: set_cache_enabled
tools.description: Turn the on-disk stream cache on or off at runtime, or query its current state.

tools.name: get_current_pmc
tools.description: Get today's Performance Management Chart (PMC) values.

tools.name: get_weekly_summary
tools.description: Get a weekly training summary for a given week (Mon–Sun).

tools.name: get_phase_summary
tools.description: Get a training phase summary with per-week breakdown and ramp rate analysis.
